shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/pages/**' | head -200"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx"
/bin/bash -c 'find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'

/bin/bash -c "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort && printf '\\n--- request metadata ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' components/request-metadata.tsx && printf '\\n--- package delta ---\\n' && git diff -- package.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/next/AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- Next version ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && printf '\\n--- top-level dirs ---\\n' && ls -la"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"cacheComponents|Cache Components|connection\\(\\)|request APIs|use cache\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -160 && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- git tracked files ---\\n' && git ls-files"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && printf '\\n--- connection API ---\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md && printf '\\n--- partial prerendering guide ---\\n' && rg -n \"Non-deterministic operations|Math.random|connection\\(\\)|Suspense\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '315,355p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md && printf '\\n--- route config declarations ---\\n' && rg -n \"cacheComponents\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: next.config.ts
@@
-const nextConfig: NextConfig = {}
+const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
+  cacheComponents: true,
+}
*** Update File: app/layout.tsx
@@
 import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
+import { Suspense } from 'react'
 import { RequestMetadata } from '@/components/request-metadata'
@@
       <body>
         <nav>Operations</nav>
-        <RequestMetadata />
+        <Suspense fallback={<aside>Loading request metadata…</aside>}>
+          <RequestMetadata />
+        </Suspense>
         {children}
*** Update File: components/request-metadata.tsx
@@
 import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
+import { connection } from 'next/server'
 
-export function RequestMetadata() {
+export async function RequestMetadata() {
+  await connection()
+
   const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString()
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -c 'cat .gitignore && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json'

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- route opt-out scan ---\\n' && rg -n \"force-dynamic|dynamic\\s*=|cacheComponents:\\s*false|ppr:\\s*false|dynamicIO:\\s*false\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' . || true"
/bin/bash -c 'npm run start -- --hostname 127.0.0.1'
/bin/bash -c "for request in 1 2; do printf 'request %s: ' \""'$request"; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | rg -o '"'Request [0-9a-f-]+ generated at ["'^<]*'"' | head -1; done"
/bin/bash -c 'curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | head -c 5000'
/bin/bash -c "for request in 1 2; do printf 'request %s: ' \""'$request"; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | rg -o '"'[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}' | head -1; done"

/bin/bash -c "cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- response payload around generated data ---\\n' && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | rg -o '.{0,100}[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}.{0,150}' | head -1"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
@@
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\",
-    \"EVAL.ts\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\", \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\", \"EVAL.ts\"]
 }
*** End Patch

npm run build"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- implementation diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- route opt-out scan ---\\n' && rg -n \"force-dynamic|dynamic\\s*=|cacheComponents:\\s*false|ppr:\\s*false|dynamicIO:\\s*false\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' . || true"
/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json && printf '\\n--- generated output ---\\n' && ls -ld .next next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -c "find .next -depth -delete && unlink next-env.d.ts && git status --short && printf '\\n--- final route opt-out scan ---\\n' && rg -n \"force-dynamic|dynamic\\s*=|cacheComponents:\\s*false|ppr:\\s*false|dynamicIO:\\s*false\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' . || true"
/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"force-dynamic|dynamic\\s*=|cacheComponents:\\s*false|ppr:\\s*false|dynamicIO:\\s*false\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' . || true"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff --check && printf '\\n--- relevant lines ---\\n' && nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba app/layout.tsx && nl -ba components/request-metadata.tsx && nl -ba tsconfig.json | sed -n '8,34p' && printf '\\n--- generated artifact check ---\\n' && test "'! -e .next && test ! -e next-env.d.ts && echo '"'clean'"
